titulo: Special Ops Convention Convenes Under 'Peace Through Strength' Strategy
descricao: More than 29,000 members of the military's special operations forces community and the public converged in person on Tampa, Fla., and virtually to kick off Special Operations Forces Week 2026.

titulo: National Defense Strategy Prioritizes America First, Leader Says
descricao: The U.S. will prioritize theaters with the greatest consequence for national interests and where only American power can play a decisive role, said Daniel Zimmerman, assistant secretary of war for international security affairs, who spoke during a hearing before the House Armed Services Committee.

titulo: Coast Guard's Newest Polar Icebreaker Returns Home Following Arctic Deployment
descricao: The Coast Guard cutter Storis completed a 36-day Bering Sea deployment to test its capabilities and train for high-risk Arctic missions.

titulo: At Fort Campbell, Hegseth Underscores Significance of Purple Hearts, Enlistments
descricao: During a visit with the 101st Airborne Division at Fort Campbell, Ky., as part of its "Week of the Eagles" celebration, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth administered the oath of enlistment to a handful of screaming eagle soldiers and pinned Purple Heart medals to the chests of nine others.

titulo: Army Advances Barracks Modernization Efforts to Improve Quality of Life
descricao: The Army has accelerated efforts to strengthen quality-of-life investments across installations, showing a long-term commitment to ensuring soldiers live and work in facilities that reflect the professionalism, standards and readiness expectations of the service.

titulo: Fueling the Fight: USNS Kanawha Completes Strategic Deployment
descricao: Family and friends gathered on the pier at Naval Station Norfolk, Va., to welcome home the crew of the USNS Kanawha. The fleet replenishment oiler and its 92 civil service mariners returned after a 204-day deployment, including 156 days at sea.

titulo: High-Pressure Field Artillery Creates Bonds Between Soldiers
descricao: Behind the massive firepower of field artillery are tight-knit soldiers driven by deep trust and family-like bonds.

titulo: Hegseth Welcomes Ford Carrier Strike Group Home After Record-Breaking Deployment
descricao: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth was on hand with his wife, Jennifer, and numerous senior Navy leaders at Naval Station Norfolk, Va., to welcome home sailors assigned to USS Gerald R. Ford Carrier Strike Group after a record-setting, multi-month deployment.

titulo: Pentagon Marks Armed Forces Day With Special Flag
descricao: The War Department celebrated Armed Forces Day with a newly unveiled America 250 version of the Betsy Ross flag, unfurled over the outside of the Pentagon.

titulo: Future USS Cleveland Sailors Attend Commissioning Week Events
descricao: Sailors assigned to the future USS Cleveland, the 16th and final Freedom-variant littoral combat ship to be built and commissioned for the Navy, arrived in their namesake city to launch a week of community engagement and celebration leading up to the ship's commissioning.

titulo: Africom Commander Says Continent at 'Crossroads' of Global Commerce, Security
descricao: Air Force Gen. Dagvin R.M. Anderson, commander of U.S. Africa Command, told Congress that as Africa ascends on the world stage, it faces a precarious situation due to bad actors operating throughout the region.

titulo: Centcom Commander Says Epic Fury Crippled Iran, Enhanced Military Partnerships in Region
descricao: Since the launch of Operation Epic Fury, American forces in the U.S. Central Command area of operations crippled Iran's military and its ability to project power, according to War Department leaders.

titulo: Air Force Pilots Receive Distinguished Flying Cross for Midnight Hammer Heroics
descricao: Six F-16 Fighting Falcon pilots assigned to the 55th Fighter Squadron received the Distinguished Flying Cross for their heroic actions in combat operations during a ceremony at Shaw Air Force Base, S.C.

titulo: Senior Leaders Update Congress on Special Ops Community
descricao: Four of the most senior leaders from the U.S. military's special operations forces community appeared before the Senate Armed Services Committee in Washington to provide an update on the SOF components within their respective branches of service.

titulo: U.S., Multinational Allies Launch Exercise Salaknib's Second Phase in the Philippines
descricao: The Army's 25th Infantry Division, in close partnership with the Armed Forces of the Philippines and multinational allies, officially launched the Joint Pacific Multinational Readiness Center-Exportable Exercise, Part II of the bilateral Exercise Salaknib.

titulo: Army, Forest Service Complete Annual Prescribed Burn in Hawaii
descricao: U.S. Army Garrison Hawaii and the U.S. Forest Service successfully completed the annual prescribed burn of the training area at Schofield Barracks, Hawaii, treating approximately 1,707 acres of invasive vegetation to reduce wildfire risk and maintain the integrity of military training lands.

titulo: Washington National Guard Aviation Crews Train for Wildfire Season
descricao: Aviation crews assigned to the 1st Battalion, 168th Aviation Regiment, Washington Army National Guard, partnered with Central Pierce Fire and Rescue to conduct water bucket training near Puyallup, Wash., preparing for the state's wildfire season.

titulo: Hegseth Welcomes South Korean Counterpart to Pentagon
descricao: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth welcomed South Korean Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-back to Washington for a bilateral engagement at the Pentagon.

titulo: Partner Nations Hammer Out Foundation for Digital Transformation at Leadership Summit
descricao: The Five Eyes alliance concluded its Digital Leadership Summit at the Pentagon, focusing on Project Arcadia to synchronize digital transformation and enhance data supremacy for coalition forces.

titulo: Forging Tactical Readiness During Iron Ascent
descricao: The 92nd Air Refueling Wing launched Iron Ascent, a three-day tactical training course at Fairchild Air Force Base, Washington, that enabled airmen from various career fields to operate as capable expeditionary warfighters.

titulo: Blount Island Command's Ship-to-Shore Operations Reinforces Southcom Readiness
descricao: Marines landed an MK36 Wrecker tactical armored vehicle at Marine Corps Support Facility Blount Island in Jacksonville, Fla., demonstrating how the service rapidly moves equipment to support operations across the region.

titulo: Joint Force Provides Post-Typhoon Relief in Pacific
descricao: Sailors and Marines assigned to the USS Boxer Amphibious Ready Group and the 11th Marine Expeditionary Unit supported Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands' civil and local authorities in their recovery efforts from Super Typhoon Sinlaku.
